# Vendored vendor docs (agent reference)

Doc-only, plain-markdown copies of official vendor agent documentation, committed for offline, version-pinned agent reference. No executable scripts, hooks, or plugins. Fetched 2026-07-08 from each vendor's own docs site (the canonical "docs for agents" markdown / llms.txt), not the community skill repos.

| File | Source | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `posthog-nextjs.md` | https://posthog.com/docs/libraries/next-js.md | PostHog analytics SDK (Next.js App Router) |
| `posthog-feature-flags.md` | https://posthog.com/docs/feature-flags/adding-feature-flag-code.md | PostHog feature flags |
| `posthog-experiments.md` | https://posthog.com/docs/experiments/adding-experiment-code.md | PostHog A/B experiments |
| `cloudflare-d1.llms-full.txt` | https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/llms-full.txt | Cloudflare D1 |
| `cloudflare-email-service.llms-full.txt` | https://developers.cloudflare.com/email-service/llms-full.txt | Cloudflare Email Service |

To refresh: re-fetch each source URL. The relevant live source is also linked in each task's ticket.
